exposure: admission to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit
outcome: prevalence of preterm neonates in NICU
systemic morbidities (respiratory problems, metabolic problems, sepsis, renal problems)
cohort: Preterm neonates (born before 37 completed weeks of gestation) admitted to a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit.
finding: The prevalence of preterm neonates in the NICU was 22.75%, with respiratory problems being the most common morbidity (86.39%).
gest_age: median 33 weeks (range 24-36 weeks); all born before 37 completed weeks of gestation
